Create ONE transparent RGBA square image with exactly SIX separate items of ONE matching equipment set in an invisible 3 columns x 2 rows grid, each centered in its own cell with wide transparent margins, never touching each other or the canvas edge: row 1: (1) a one-handed sword, (2) a different second weapon of the same set: a radiant greatsword with a sunburst guard, (3) a helmet; row 2: (4) a chest armor, (5) leg armor pants, (6) a pair of boots. All six share one design language: FALLEN SUN GOD set: radiant gold and dark bronze, sunburst crown rays, eclipse black discs, ember-orange glow, divine and imposing. Each item clearly readable at small icon size. Actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no labels, no characters.
